card.name: Complement inhibitor drug label terms
card.fires_on: The word complement (and pieces of aHUS or EPYSQLI) in labels for complement-inhibitor drugs such as eculizumab, especially right after "a" or "other".

modes.label: complement after a
modes.description: The word complement right after "a" or "other" in phrases like "a complement inhibitor" or "terminal complement activation".
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS MENINGOCOCCAL INFECTIONS ULTOMIRIS, a<< complement>> inhibitor, increases the risk of serious infections

modes.label: Inside aHUS and EPYSQLI
modes.description: Pieces of the disease abbreviation aHUS or the brand name EPYSQLI partway through the term.
modes.example: monitor patients with a<<H>>US for signs and symptoms of thrombot

card.writes: It pushes toward complement-related continuations such as complement, activation and system terms, including Chinese ones.
card.plain: It lights up on the word complement and related names in labels for complement-blocking drugs.
